notes: Stub casing preserved; official name in paper and blog is 'BrowseComp'. Dataset originally 1,287 questions; 21 removed after Deep Research 0% pass-rate review, leaving 1,266. Code distributed via openai/simple-evals. Leaderboard snapshot from llm-stats.com captured 2026-04-25 (drafts/browsecomp/BrowseComp Leaderboard.mhtml + 43 chart-tooltip screenshots): all 45 models in the ranking table now carry submission dates from the Progress Over Time chart tooltips. The 'effort' field on leaderboard rows carries each model's context-window length from the llm-stats.com ranking table (e.g., '1.0M', '262K'); null where the table shows '—'. effort is null on paper rows since the paper's Table 3 doesn't report context windows.
